Graphic Design Studio v0.3.0

Twelve design methods with production helpers, a four-tool MCP runtime, presentations, plotting and pet workflows.

Download v0.3.0 ZIPOpen the original release

Record notes

Twelve design methods with production helpers, a four-tool MCP runtime, presentations, plotting and pet workflows.

Version 0.3.0 includes 12 complete skill procedures. Complete design methods and original production runtime; retained Apache pet workflow; optional providers remain external.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared dependencies for local runtime; Design Templates for optional chooser; Host image tools for generation.

License scope: MIT first-party runtime and methods; MIT/Apache-2.0 imports; CC-BY-SA-4.0 methodology; optional PyMuPDF separately licensed AGPL/commercial. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add graphic-design-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from ccfc84e7affdc6a0e9990f88e92e34829403d2ff. SHA-256: 4bb9704b089c60dac2dd57d02f028a6bb2f40b51808c2a62f81b556c4353114b.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
